```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}

## Load library and working directory

suppressMessages(library(tidyverse))
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
library(titanic)
library(faraway)
library(faraway)
library(GGally)  

```

```{r}

## Creating Histograms

data("titanic_train", package = "titanic")
titanic <- titanic_train

histogram <- ggplot(titanic, aes(x = Fare)) +
geom_histogram(bins = 15) +
  ggtitle("Histogram") +
  xlab("Fare Cost") +
   theme_minimal()

histogram

```

```{r}

## Creating scatter-plots

data("worldcup", package = "faraway")
world_cup <- worldcup
scatter <- ggplot(world_cup, aes(x = Time, y = Passes)) + 
geom_point() +
  geom_smooth() +
  ggtitle("Scatterplot") +
  theme_minimal()

scatter

```

```{r}

## Boxplots

boxplot <- ggplot(nepali, aes(x = 1, y = ht)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  xlab("")+ ylab("Height (cm)") +
  theme_minimal()

boxplot

```

```{r}

## Exploratory data analysis

eda <- ggpairs(titanic %>% select(Fare, Age, Survived))

```

```{r}

## Data Cleaning

nepali <- nepali %>%
  select(id, sex, wt, ht, age) %>%
  mutate(id = factor(id),
         sex = factor(sex, levels = c(1, 2),
                      labels = c("Male", "Female"))) %>%

  distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)

```
